desc: First graphical boot: Alpine + Xorg + dwm on the internal panel. Object m1n1-b0-alpine-dwm.bin c40b6ed9c439fc4aec804cc2c3e6657add49a7a0fcaa5813b4b87d0fb9fbc0b0 (21,725,184 B, 1326 pages, strict verify PASS) = window-free m1n1 v7 ecd264a5 + diet kernel efba5999 (4 KiB pages, the PROVEN one) + DTB 2782b922 + initramfs-alpine-dwm.cpio.xz 40073ac9 (14.93 MiB, expands to 65 MiB), bootargs rdinit=/sbin/init. Ships Xorg modesetting with AccelMethod none + ShadowFB + AutoAddGPU false + AllowMouseOpenFail true (the trackpad is unsupported, tickets 004/126, and dwm is keyboard-driven so a missing pointer is not a loss), setxkbmap no for the Norwegian layout, st spawned then exec dwm, and a getty on tty1 as an escape hatch. Prefer a TETHERED KIS smoke (needs 146) since /var/log/xorg-startx.log is the first thing to read on failure; then enroll for an untethered graphical boot. Pass = dwm visible on the panel with a usable st terminal driven by the internal keyboard. WATCH FOR: modesetting failing to probe simpledrm (the diet kernel drops DRM_TTM/DRM_SCHED/DRM_DISPLAY_HELPER — if that is the cause, a graphical-capable DIET variant is the fix, not a config tweak), and Xorg refusing to start without a pointer. NOTE llvmpipe was deliberately trimmed, so there is NO software GL — GL clients will fail by design. Evidence: done/2026-07-25-t6040-dwm-image-design.md.
author: claude
note: 2026-07-26: NOT gated by 147 — this object uses the PROVEN 4 KiB diet kernel efba5999, not the 16 KiB DIET_CAPABLE one. Only enabler 146 was required and it is now done.
staged: 2026-07-26: object VERIFIED and ready to chainload. m1n1-b0-alpine-dwm.bin c40b6ed9 (21,725,184 B = 1326 x 16 KiB, aligned), strict verify PASS: m1n1 v7 ecd264a5 + PROVEN 4 KiB diet kernel efba5999 + DTB 2782b922 + initramfs-alpine-dwm.cpio.xz 40073ac9 (14.93 MiB) + bootargs 3659a0da (the proven B0 set, rdinit=/sbin/init). NOT gated by 147 (that cleared the 16 KiB kernel; this uses the 4 KiB one). RUN: bash scripts/t6040-boot-raw-object.sh ~/Code/linux-build-out/m1n1-b0-alpine-dwm.bin c40b6ed9c439fc4aec804cc2c3e6657add49a7a0fcaa5813b4b87d0fb9fbc0b0 then read /var/log/xorg-startx.log on failure.
result: 2026-07-26 FAIL, root-caused. Correct object ran (0x14b8004 = c40b6ed9 + 4), m1n1 handed off cleanly, Linux booted, keyboard on event0, tty1 getty worked — but Xorg died fatally and dwm never started. /var/log/xorg-startx.log: 'Unable to open socket for local'/'for unix', 'Cannot establish any listening sockets', 'xinit: unable to connect to X server: Function not implemented'. ENOSYS, because config-b0-diet has '# CONFIG_NET is not set' so CONFIG_UNIX does not exist; X11 requires an AF_UNIX listening socket, so the server dies before touching the display. NEITHER predicted failure mode (simpledrm probe / missing pointer) was involved — both are downstream of socket creation. This is a direct casualty of kernel stripping. SECOND defect: the image ships gzipped keymaps (no/no-mac.bmap.gz) while the inittab reads no-mac.bmap, so the console keymap silently failed ('can't open ...: no such file'); setxkbmap no never ran either since X never started, so the image had no Norwegian layout by either path. Fixed in scripts/t6040-build-alpine-dwm.sh (try .bmap then zcat the .bmap.gz). NEXT: ticket 155 rebuilds on a full-featured kernel rather than adding symbols one failure at a time — note DIET_CAPABLE does enable UNIX/NET/INET/PACKET/SYSVIPC (and 147 cleared it) but does NOT re-add DRM_TTM/DRM_SCHED/DRM_DISPLAY_HELPER, so fixing AF_UNIX may only advance to the simpledrm/modesetting failure originally predicted. Evidence: done/2026-07-26-t6040-dwm-boot-result.md. | 2026-07-26 GRAPHICAL TARGET REACHED with the full kernel: object 6738aad9 loads dwm on the internal panel (tags 1-9, []= layout, st, dwm-6.8, blue border, shell prompt). Xorg started and modesetting drove simpledrm, so the two risks this ticket named are both settled — the simpledrm probe works, and the actual killer was CONFIG_UNIX/AF_UNIX, not the DRM helpers. Remaining gap is input only: no udevd/udevadm in the image meant libinput enumerated nothing (ticket 161, fix built as 3ec81ef3).
